description: This source file defines the PdfToUnicodeMap class, which represents a ToUnicode map for composite fonts within the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for constructing the map from CMapInfo, preparing it for saving by generating the correct PDF content stream, and handling compression of the stream.

classes.name: PdfToUnicodeMap
classes.description: Represents a ToUnicode map for composite fonts in a PDF, derived from PdfDictionary, providing functionality to generate the map stream from CMapInfo.

methods.name: PdfToUnicodeMap
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the map with a PdfDocument.

methods.name: PdfToUnicodeMap
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the map with a PdfDocument and CMapInfo.

methods.name: PrepareForSave
methods.description: Generates the ToUnicode map stream content based on the CMapInfo, encodes it, and sets up compression if enabled.
